member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.AssemblyExtraction
member.summary:
Assembly extraction payload. Mirrors schemas/v1/assembly.schema.json — which in turn mirrors the existing 400S_Sorted_Library/assemblies/<asm>_assembly.json shape exactly per Phase-1 Decision 2 ("match the existing shape").
Linear units are METERS (matching the existing library convention). No units field is emitted — backward-compatible with the manually-authored files. Mate angles are radians; mate distances are meters.

member.name: P:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.AssemblyExtraction.MateRelationships
member.summary: Pairwise component-pair summary synthesised from . Mirrors the existing library shape. The extractor always emits inspectionRequirements: [] — downstream tooling populates.

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.ComponentTransform
member.summary: Component transform from IComponent2.Transform2. Translation in meters, rotation a 3x3 row-major matrix flattened to 9 numbers. Collections use empty defaults — Newtonsoft's default ObjectCreationHandling.Auto appends to non-empty defaults during deserialization, which would silently double element counts.

member.name: P:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.ComponentTransform.Quaternion
member.summary: Always emitted (matches library shape). Empty list when the rotation matrix is degenerate; otherwise [x, y, z, w].

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.DrawingMap
member.summary: Drawing map. Mirrors schemas/v1/drawing_map.schema.json. Coordinates are millimetres from the top-left of the sheet.

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.Manifest
member.summary: Top-level manifest for an .inspectorpkg package. Mirrors schemas/v1/manifest.schema.json. Field shape is contractual — changes require an ADR + schemaVersion bump.

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.PartExtraction
member.summary: Part extraction payload. Mirrors schemas/v1/part.schema.json. All linear dimensions in mm; masses in kg; moments in kg*mm^2. Active-config-only payload per Phase-1 Decision 3; other configurations appear in as metadata-only summaries.

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.PartBoundingBox
member.summary: Part axis-aligned bounding box plus optional tight feature-derived bounding box. Named PartBoundingBox to avoid collision with any future drawing-side bounding box type.

member.name: T:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.SchemaResources
member.summary: Reads embedded JSON schema files shipped with this assembly. Callers do not need filesystem access to the repo's schemas/ folder.

member.name: M:InspectorPro.PackageSchema.SchemaResources.LoadSchemaJson(System.String)
member.summary: Loads an embedded schema as a JSON string.
